title: Natural affine model stalk tensor transport
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], V an open of Z, z a point of V, and U an affine open of Y containing i(z). Put A=O_Y(U), S=O_Y,i(z), R=O_V,z [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], with S→R the composite stalk map and A→R the composite germ and stalk maps. Let T be tilde [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] followed by restriction along the affine chart isomorphism. There exists a family of additive equivalences R tensor over S with F_i(z) ≃ R tensor over A with M, for each module sheaf F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], A-module M and model isomorphism e:F|U≅T(M). It is natural in compatible c:F→G and d:M→N: whenever c|U followed by eG equals eF followed by T(d), this family intertwines baseChange R of c.stalkLinearMap with baseChange R of d.

source.place: Lemma 17.10.5(3), functorial associated-module stalk formula; inverse image and scalar extension stalk comparison (Tags 008H, 0098)

proof.text: Apply the natural local-ring presentation at x=i(z) from [new-e3-affine-model-stalk-presentation]. It gives S-linear equivalences delta(F,M,e): S tensor_A M -> F_x and their naturality squares.

Equip S with the germ A-algebra and use the defining composite rho to verify IsScalarTower A S R. Define gamma as the inverse of delta extended from S to R, followed by Mathlib TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A S R R M. Its inverse sends r tensor m to r tensor delta(1 tensor m). Prove the inverse naturality equality by tensor induction: zero and sum use additivity, and pure tensors use the naturality of delta at 1 tensor m. Apply injectivity of the inverse equivalence to obtain the stated naturality of gamma. No localization inversion or scalar-extension glue remains unproved.

theorem exists_affine_model_stalk_tensor_transport
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (V : Z.Opens) (z : V.toScheme)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (hzU : i z.1 ∈ U.1) :
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let S := (Y.presheaf.stalk (i z.1) : Type u)
    let R := (V.toScheme.presheaf.stalk z : Type u)
    let φ : S →+* R := (i.stalkMap z.1 ≫ V.ι.stalkMap z).hom
    letI : Algebra S R := φ.toAlgebra
    let ρ : A →+* R := ((Y.presheaf.germ U.1 (i z.1) hzU) ≫
      i.stalkMap z.1 ≫ V.ι.stalkMap z).hom
    letI : Algebra A R := ρ.toAlgebra
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    ∃ γ : ∀ (F : Y.Modules) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A),
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅ T.obj M) →
        (R ⊗[S] F.presheaf.stalk (i z.1)) ≃+ R ⊗[A] M,
      ∀ (F G : Y.Modules) (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A) (c : F ⟶ G) (d : M ⟶ N)
        (eF : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅ T.obj M)
        (eG : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj G ≅ T.obj N),
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).map c ≫ eG.hom = eF.hom ≫ T.map d →
        ∀ x, γ G N eG ((c.stalkLinearMap (i z.1)).baseChange R x) =
          d.hom.baseChange R (γ F M eF x)
